blind.B1: Yes. Parkinson's disease patients (PBMC/leukocytes) sampled before and 48-72 h after a 12-week exercise program (S2.2.p1, S3.3.p1). All 42 RNA-seq samples (21 patients x before/after, group 1) carry the exercise factor as the time contrast; there is no non-exercise control arm, so the estimand is a within-patient pre/post change. Group 2 (19 patients) is qPCR/immunoassay only (S3.3.p1).
blind.B2: Single main comparison: after vs before exercise, tai chi and MET pooled (S3.3.p1: exercise type gave no transcriptomic difference, so combined). 21 before + 21 after samples from 21 patients (10 tai chi, 11 MET at randomization, S3.1.p1).
blind.B3: Yes. Each of the 21 patients is sampled twice (before and after). Packet A keys: `subject` (and the description suffix) occur once in each time level and link 42/42 samples. The paper used a paired test to avoid individual differences (S2.4.p1).
blind.B4: One paired comparison of all 21 before/after pairs (S2.4.p1: 'Samples in two conditions (before and after exercise) were applied to paired student t-test to avoid individual differences'). Tai chi vs MET was not fitted separately for DEGs (S3.3.p1).
blind.B5: S2.4.p1: 'Significantly differentially expressed genes (DEGs, P < 0.05)' by paired Student t-test on Cuffnorm FPKM; raw P, no multiple-testing correction, no fold-change cutoff. Counts: 1,873 DEGs, of which 1,453 higher before and 417 higher after (S3.3.p1); 1,453 + 417 = 1,870, an internal mismatch of 3.

checks.evidence: Analyzed: PD patients before/after a 12-week exercise program (S3.3.p1); packet A shows 42 samples with before/after labels. The caveat that no sedentary control exists is recorded in the study caveats.

time: before 21 / after 21, matching the paper (21 patients, 42 samples, S3.3.p1). Subject from title regex gives 21 patients x 2. The a22 MET/Tai chi label conflict is recorded as a discrepancy and does not affect the pooled contrast.
control=before, treatment=after; all 14 paper-named genes move in the paper's direction (ODC1, CD3E, FOS, TNFRSF18 down; TRAF3, TNF, AGAP2 up) per the gene check in the study record.

covariance record: blocking term subject, design ~ C(subject)+time, rank 22, full rank, residual df 20; subject treated as a category. Packet A key subject links 42/42 samples with 0 duplicates in a level.
One paired fit over all 21 pairs, matching B4. Tai chi and MET separately was considered and rejected with reasons.

Pre/post design without control (season, time, medication drift; paper S4.p7 notes climate) is recorded in the study caveats. extype is constant within subject and absorbed by the subject block. Six Ion Proton sequencing runs (S2.3.p1) are not in the metadata, so no run-level aliasing can be checked; not raised by the analysis, but nothing in packet A shows alias with time.
Cuffnorm FPKM, linear scale, max 84,329, non-integer; routed to limma on log2(FPKM+1), count methods excluded. p-value histogram is not pathological (frac p>0.9 = 0.078, frac p<0.05 = 0.093).

Applied rule pvalue < 0.05, non-inclusive, no fold change, transcribed from S2.4.p1; BH padj<0.05 kept as audit (0 genes). Packet B table shows no other rule fits 1,873 better (pvalue<0.05 gives 1984). The effect_metric field names log2FoldChange with a null cutoff, which is harmless.

Ours 1,984 vs paper 1,873 for the same contrast and rule; the HANDBACK table also lists up 529 vs 417 and down 1,455 vs 1,453 and states the audit result and that AGAP2 is not significant (P=0.065). The route is declared as a deviation (limma moderated paired test vs ordinary paired t-test on FPKM); it does not claim a reproduction.
No stop or refusal in this case (flags.json stop_claims empty). The blocked paper route (no validated paired-t executor) is recorded as a deviation, not a stop.

human_items: Open policy question: the paper's numbers fit its raw P<0.05 rule on a paired t-test, while our limma route gives 1,984 (up count 529 vs 417); whether to add a plain paired t-test executor to close the gap is a policy choice, not an error.
summary: 该案例的决策与论文一致：21名患者运动前后配对（共42个样本），以subject作为区组，limma在log2(FPKM+1)上拟合，方向为after对before，阈值按论文的原始P<0.05转录并记录了padj审计结果（0个）。没有发现阻断性或主要问题，唯一需人工关注的是论文使用普通配对t检验、而我们使用limma，导致数量略有差异（1984对1873），这已作为偏离明确记录。
